name: bundled-simple-message-parser
description: Controlled mutation testing of the project-owned SM message parser; no external target is contacted.

failure_policy.rejected: expected parser rejection, not a finding
failure_policy.crash: group by exception type plus defect location; reduce while preserving exception type, defect location and key byte conditions
failure_policy.timeout: separate timing-related finding; repeat trials and record reproduction rate; never merge with crashes
failure_policy.runner_error: preserve current sample and abnormal process exit code
